pf.btn_title: Plan preferences: training days, time caps, sessions, auto-adjust
pf.title: ⚙ Plan preferences
pf.title_tip: Only changes automatic sessions you haven't done or edited; after saving you preview the changes before they apply.
pf.wh_tip:
Auto: build volume by the CTL ramp rule.
Custom: at most this many hours a week.
pf.cap_mode_tip:
Try to stay under: volume that doesn't fit goes to the long-run day first.
Never exceed: volume that doesn't fit is dropped for the week, and you're told.
pf.quality_tip: Auto: at most 1. When base-phase intervals start depends on the interval gate under Advanced.
pf.sdays_tip: None selected = same day as an easy run.
pf.basis_tip:
Whether session targets use heart rate or power.
Auto: road easy and long runs use power with HR capped at the easy-run cap; trail easy runs, long mountain days and recovery runs use HR (≤ the easy-run cap); intervals and 3–8% hill repeats use power with HR as a ceiling alert; long climbs and downhill practice have no target; CP tests use power, AeT tests follow the test protocol.
Heart rate: HR zones everywhere (your workout HR zones; easy-run cap = the Z2 top, or a measured AeT when you have one).
Power: power zones everywhere (Palladino % CP); tests and downhills keep their own rules.
Only affects sessions the planner makes; each step can still be switched to power, HR or pace in the session's structure, and templates keep their source's targets.
pf.auto_tip: After each sync, adjusts the coming sessions to what you actually did. Reductions (fatigue protection, missed sessions not made up, easy runs that ran hard shortened) apply and push right away; sessions you edited or added and blocked dates are never touched. This section saves with Save; Recalculate now saves it first, then runs.
pf.ap_big_tip: Big changes wait for your approval and the watch keeps the old sessions (thresholds are an estimate):
pf.ap_login: Log in to COROS to push the plan to your watch automatically
pf.gate_na: Your data now: can't be computed
pf.gate_no: Your data now: ✗ not usable yet — {why}
pf.warmup_tip: Easy running the warm-up must include (e.g. running from home to the interval spot); interval sessions never cut it.
pf.cpp_tip.quick: 20 min all-out. About 37 min; CP ≈ 0.95 × 20-min power, about ±3%, no W′.
pf.cpp_tip.standard: 12 min + 30 min rest + 3 min. About 70 min; two-point CP + W′, the most accurate; the rest can't be shortened.
pf.cpp_tip.race: A 5–10 K race or time trial. Not scheduled separately; Riegel conversion (extrapolated), no W′.
pf.aet_tip: The protocol decides what is scheduled and how it is read; the interval gate decides when zone 5 opens. The 90′ long-run test goes on the weekend long-run day (a Taiwanese coach); the others follow "AeT on". Scheduled only when needed: the pooled estimate is unreliable or drifting, no readable run for about 6 weeks, or after a ≥ 4-week break (estimate). Starts when it is 25 °C or cooler.
pf.aet_days_tip:
Weekdays: Monday to Friday.
Like intervals: Tuesday first, weekends allowed.
pf.b2b_tip: Two long days in a row. Suggested only in the specific phase, before a multi-day or ≥ 6 h A race, in the first build week after a recovery week; never scheduled automatically — pick two consecutive days in the suggestion box and press Add. Once added the two days are your own sessions, auto-adjust leaves them alone; deleting one cancels the pair.
pf.heat_tip: On: scheduled only when a hot A / B race is within 30 days. Induction 21–8 days before the race (5–10 days), then a top-up every 4 days from 7–3 days out; heat runs need ≥ 60 min (Racinais 2015) and ignore the session cap; with "Never exceed" they become a 40 min run + hot bath (Zurawlew 2016). Hot baths / sauna aren't pushed to COROS; tick them off on the calendar.
pf.heat_m_tip:
Hot easy run: 60 min, HR ≤ the easy-run cap.
Overdressed run: for cool days.
Hot bath: after the run, 40 °C ≤ 40 min.
Sauna: after the run, about 30 min.
Mixed: runs and hot baths alternate.
pf.saved_conflicts: Saved. Some preferences conflict with the default rules above: tick "Keep my choice" and save again, or just save again to let the plan follow the rules.

pf.rc_cancel: Preferences saved, plan not replanned yet — press "Replan from progress" later to apply them
